Campers report C$33-35 a night (2024). --Claude  CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: C$33-40 a night in July-September 2026 (RV Life reviews); the park has no web page, only Facebook (2026-10-11). --Claude

name: Crowhill RV Park
note: RV park on Route 60 (Conception Bay Hwy) in Brigus, ~80 km west of St. John's; 118 sites, 3-way 30-amp hookups. Comfort station, convenience store, dump station, walking trail. Season about May 9-Oct 13. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: 3-way 30-amp hookups $35 plus tax.

name: Heritage Country Camping
note: Family campground on Route 105 at Lower Queensbury above the Saint John River headpond; RV semi/full-service sites, 7th night free; seasonal sites too. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: 2025: RV semi/full service under 30 ft $50, 30-34 ft $55, 35 ft+ $65; 2-way tent trailer $45.

name: Wayside Camping Park

field_notes.Fees: Wayside: 30-amp 2- and 3-way sites C$50, 50-amp 3-way C$55; unserviced tent sites C$45. Read 2026-10-15.

name: Oakhill Pines Campground

name: Valley R&R Campground

field_notes.Fees: Unserviced $45, 2-way 15-amp $55, 2-way 30-amp $57, 3-way 30-amp $62, 3-way 50-amp $67 per night plus HST.

name: Englishtown Ridge RV and Campground
note: Campground on the Cabot Trail (Route 312) at Englishtown, above St. Ann's Bay near the ferry; full 30-amp RV sites, 50-amp, 2-way; tipi and deck rentals. Online booking (ResNexus). Formerly Kluskap Ridge. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: 2-way $45, full 30-amp $60, full 50-amp $65 per night.

name: Pyott's West Campground
note: Campground on Lake of the Prairies near Roblin, 10 minutes from the Saskatchewan line; daily sites 30-amp, 50-amp full hookup (call to book); also sells and leases seasonal lots in an adjoining lot community. Fishing destination. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: 30-amp $55/day, 50-amp full hookup $60/day.

name: Cedar Cove Camping

field_notes.Fees: 2-way or 3-way 30-amp $50/night + HST; 2-way $40 + HST.

name: Fort Lions Campground

name: Gibbs Camping & RV Resort
note: Good Sam Park on Shallow Lake beside Trans-Canada Hwy 11 at Mattice-Val Côté (between Hearst and Kapuskasing): 3-service RV lots and pull-throughs, tent lots, RV rentals, pool, chip stand, fishing; seasonal contracts too. name: Sunshine Valley RV Resort & Cabins
note: Holiday Trails Resorts park at 14850 Alpine Blvd in Sunshine Valley on Hwy 3, about 20 km east of Hope near Manning Park: 110 fully serviced 50A RV sites (back-ins, pull-throughs and ATV sites), tent camping and 10 cabins; Great Room event hall; open year-round to members and the public. A Tuesday mid-October 2026 night sells online for a full-hookup site plus a C$7 reservation fee and tax. Booked online (RezExpert), 7-day cancellation, 19+ to book; Good Sam/BCAA discounts by phone. Caveat (2026-10-08): summer 2027 rates were not yet loaded, so the quote is a shoulder-season night. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Full-hookup site C$49/night plus a C$7 reservation fee and tax (a mid-October 2026 night). From our own note; not re-confirmed with the operator as of 2026-10-11.
